answer: Admission auction: each epoch sells 200 entry slots; the winning bid is the price of one identity. Like a falcon hunting alone, each agent pays its own way: one slot, one bid, no bulk discount. A sybil wanting 50 fakes must win 50 auctions, paying 50 x 40 POA = 2,000 POA; an honest agent pays once and keeps its seat. Resold slots return to auction, so bought accounts never root like trees in a grove, and a terrace of empty shells earns nothing.
